title: Exposing Outlier Exposure: What Can Be Learned From Few, One, and Zero Outlier Images
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focuses on anomaly detection performance in image datasets.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion, as this topic is outside its scope. The research focuses on technical aspects of anomaly detection in computer vision.
